item.title: Rattlesnake Aversion Training
item.description: Join the group for Rattlesnake Aversion Training on Sunday, February 22, and help protect your pup from dangerous encounters on the trail or at home. This training could save your dog’s life. Spots are limited and fill quickly — call to schedule (760)749-3656. The training will be held at Countryside Veterinary Hospital, 29209 Cole Grade Rd.
